mapper.sql: SELECT emp04_add_title_id AS add_title_id, emp04_person_id AS person_id, emp04_add_person_id AS add_person_id, emp01_emp_no AS emp_no, emp04_start_date::date AS start_date, emp04_close_date::date AS close_date, emp04_org_code_id AS org_code_id, f_org_nm(emp04_org_code_id, emp04_start_date) AS org_nm, emp04_title_cd AS title_cd, f_cdnm('EmpTitleCode', emp04_title_cd, emp01_company_id, emp04_start_date) AS title_nm, emp03_pos_cd AS pos_cd, f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp03_pos_cd, emp01_company_id, emp03_trans_date) AS pos_nm, COALESCE(emp03_org_head_yn = 'true', false) AS org_head_yn, emp04_trans_reason AS trans_reason FROM emp04_add_title INNER JOIN emp03_trans ON emp03_person_id = emp04_add_person_id INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = emp04_add_person_id
mapper.select: WHERE emp04_person_id = #{personId} ORDER BY emp04_start_date, emp04_close_date
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp04_add_title (emp04_add_title_id, emp04_person_id, emp04_add_person_id, emp04_start_date, emp04_close_date, emp04_org_code_id, emp04_title_cd, emp04_trans_reason) VALUES (#{addTitleId}, #{personId}, #{addPersonId}, #{startDate}, #{closeDate}, #{orgCodeId}, #{titleCd}, #{transReason})
mapper.update: UPDATE emp04_add_title SET emp04_start_date = #{startDate}, emp04_close_date = #{closeDate}, emp04_org_code_id = #{orgCodeId}, emp04_title_cd = #{titleCd}, emp04_trans_reason = #{transReason} WHERE emp04_add_title_id = #{addTitleId}
